records.dataset: audit
caveats: Audit record: value is the legacy number being audited, NOT a linking accuracy.

details.verdict: NOT AN ACCURACY: the reported 'Linking Accuracy' (0.890374 Full CAG/Graph, 0.889834 safe wrapper) is coverage = share of predicted spans that received any canonical id. No gold link was compared. It is additionally partly circular: the 711-row alias table it links into was built from SkillSpan train/dev gold surfaces (601 rows) and 76 high-confidence Mistral predictions on the SAME test split, and its BM25 fallback links almost any string that shares a token with an entry.
details.computed_as: pipeline/smoke_runner.py: linked_count / total over PREDICTED spans (share with any non-null canonical id)
details.taxonomy_reranker: placeholder (train_taxonomy_reranker writes a README only); build_linker_dataset writes an empty file
details.linking_eval_csv: taxonomy_linking_accuracy=0.0 because supervised reranker labels are unavailable (linking_eval.md)
